newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar closes firmer despite weak open.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar closes firmer despite weak open.

text.p: * Canada's dollar closed firmer at C$1.3440 (US$0.7441) from Monday's close at 1.3445 (US$0.7438) in active trading.
* The currency weakened overnight as European investors showed their disappointment in the performance of Canadian financial markets, dealers said.
* The currency then strengthened on positive U.S. data.
The Canadian bond market rallied after the U.S. Labor Department reported that employment costs for the third quarter rose 0.6 percent, slightly below expectations.
The report increased expectations that the U.S. Federal Reserve would not raise interest rates.
The data and the bond market rally boosted the Canadian dollar, dealers said.
On the crosses, Canada's dollar fell to 1.1234 marks from 1.1295 marks on Monday but rose to 85.05 yen from 84.92 yen.
